profile.name: Irawan Agung Nugroho
profile.headline: Senior Backend Engineer & Golang Specialist
about: Adaptable software engineer with 15+ years of experience and a diverse background in IT and data analytics, now specializing in cloud-native application development. Skilled in Go, PHP, JavaScript, Docker, AWS, and Kubernetes.

I design and maintain end-to-end web applications with Golang backends, Next.js frontends, and CI/CD pipelines, while also leading engineering teams through sprint planning, code review, and deployment management.

research.narrative: My focus is designing cloud-native backend systems that remain reliable under load: clean service boundaries, observable pipelines, and deployment workflows that teams can trust in production.

focus.name: Backend Engineering
focus.description: Golang and PHP backends with REST APIs, clean architecture, and microservices for enterprise-scale systems.

focus.name: Fullstack Development
focus.description: End-to-end application delivery with Next.js, React, React Native, and Laravel across web and mobile.

focus.name: Cloud & DevOps
focus.description: Containerized deployments with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, and CI/CD pipelines for reliable releases.

focus.name: Team Leadership
focus.description: Sprint planning, code review, mentoring, and deployment management for engineering teams.

projects.name: HOSPIRE
projects.summary: Enterprise Hospitality LMS built with Laravel 12, Vue 3, and Tailwind CSS. Combines program management, assessments, certifications, job placements, and payments with multi-language support and Docker deployment.

projects.name: ICP
projects.summary: Unified collaboration platform with real-time chat, voice/video calls, task management, file drive, calendar, and document collaboration. Built with Go REST API, WebSocket, Next.js, and React Native.

projects.name: Indotani POS
projects.summary: AI-powered POS platform for retail and agricultural businesses with multi-branch management, inventory monitoring, and financial dashboards. Built with Golang (Gin), Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Redis.

projects.name: Asset Recovery
projects.summary: Integrated asset management system with registration, distribution maps, maintenance tracking, valuation, QR code scanning, and RBAC. Built with Next.js, Golang (Gin), PostgreSQL, and Docker.

projects.name: Smart Kantin
projects.summary: Multi-platform canteen management app for Telkom dormitories. Golang API, Laravel web, React Native mobile, PostgreSQL, Midtrans payments, Firebase notifications, and Alibaba Cloud ECS deployment.

projects.name: AdhyaksaPedia
projects.summary: Public legal information platform with news, polls, events, Q&A, community complaints, helpdesk, GIS mapping, and reporting. Built for the Attorney General's office with mobile support and scalable architecture.

footer: Leveraging technology to solve complex problems and drive organizational growth.
